name: Consigaz - Gas Cond. Sao Blas 204

steps.description: Abrir o portal da Consigaz para usar o mesmo contexto CORS da SPA
Consultar as APIs da Consigaz para listar faturas, status real e linha digitavel

all_bills.script: (() => { return (async () => { const BASE_API = 'https://itdna.grupomir.com.br/consigaz'; const TOKEN_URL = `${BASE_API}/GeraToken`; const BASIC_AUTH = '{{credentials.basic_auth}}'; const ISSUER = 'Consigaz - Distribuidora de Gas Ltda - Barueri'; const injectedContext = window.__codexTemplateContext || {}; const credentials = injectedContext.credentials || {}; const unit = injectedContext.unit || {}; const metadata = unit.metadata || {}; const cpfCnpj = String(credentials.username || credentials.email || credentials.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); const expectedCodEmitente = String(metadata.cod_emitente || credentials.codigo_client || credentials.codigo_cliente || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); const expectedLocalEntrega = String(metadata.local_entrega || '').trim().toUpperCase(); const expectedAddress = String(unit.address || metadata.endereco || '').trim().toUpperCase(); const expectedAddressTokens = expectedAddress ? expectedAddress.split(/\s+/).filter((token) => token.length >= 3) : []; const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); const dateEnd = todayIso.replace(/-/g, '/'); const dateStartObj = new Date(`${todayIso}T00:00:00`); dateStartObj.setFullYear(dateStartObj.getFullYear() - 1); const dateStart = dateStartObj.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '/'); const toBrDate = (value) => { const raw = String(value || '').trim(); if (!raw) return ''; const iso = raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); if (iso) return `${iso[3]}/${iso[2]}/${iso[1]}`; const br = raw.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/); return br ? raw : ''; }; const toIsoDate = (value) => { const raw = String(value || '').trim(); if (!raw) return ''; const iso = raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`; const br = raw.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/); return br ? `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}` : ''; }; const normalizeReferenceMonth = (value, fallbackDate) => { const raw = String(value || '').trim(); const refMatch = raw.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/); if (refMatch) return `${refMatch[2]}-${refMatch[1]}`; const fallbackIso = toIsoDate(fallbackDate); return fallbackIso ? fallbackIso.slice(0, 7) : ''; }; const normalizeAmount = (value) => { if (value == null || value === '') return ''; if (typeof value === 'number') return value.toFixed(2); const raw = String(value).trim(); if (!raw) return ''; const normalized = raw.includes(',') && raw.includes('.') ? raw.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.') : raw.includes(',') ? raw.replace(',', '.') : raw; const parsed = Number(normalized); return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed.toFixed(2) : raw; }; const normalizeBarcode = (value) => { const digits = String(value || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); return digits.length >= 44 ? digits : ''; }; const isPaidStatus = (value) => /quitad|liquidad|pago|baixad/i.test(String(value || '')); const inferDisplayStatus = (status, dueDateBr) => { const raw = String(status || '').trim(); if (raw) return raw; const dueIso = toIsoDate(dueDateBr); if (dueIso && dueIso < todayIso) return 'Vencido'; return 'Aberto'; }; const mergePreferred = (current, next) => (next === undefined || next === null || next === '' ? current : next); const mergeEntry = (existing, patch) => ({ bill_id: mergePreferred(existing.bill_id, patch.bill_id), reference_month: mergePreferred(existing.reference_month, patch.reference_month), due_date: mergePreferred(existing.due_date, patch.due_date), amount: mergePreferred(existing.amount, patch.amount), status: mergePreferred(existing.status, patch.status), barcode: mergePreferred(existing.barcode, patch.barcode), issuer: mergePreferred(existing.issuer, patch.issuer), rawData: { ...(existing.rawData || {}), ...(patch.rawData || {}) } }); const fetchJson = async (url, init = {}) => { const response = await fetch(url, init); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Consigaz request failed (${response.status}) for ${url}`); return response.json(); }; if (!cpfCnpj) { window.__codexConsigazBills = []; window.__codexConsigazPrimary = null; return JSON.stringify([]); } const tokenJson = await fetchJson(TOKEN_URL, { headers: { Authorization: BASIC_AUTH, Accept: 'application/json' } }); const token = String(tokenJson?.Token || tokenJson?.token || '').trim(); if (!token) throw new Error('Consigaz token missing in GeraToken response'); const authHeaders = { token, Accept: 'application/json' }; const localEntregaJson = await fetchJson(`${BASE_API}/ConsultaLocalEntrega?${new URLSearchParams({ cpfcnpj: cpfCnpj, versao: '1' }).toString()}`, { headers: authHeaders }); const customerRows = Array.isArray(localEntregaJson?.Cliente?.ClienteRetorno) ? localEntregaJson.Cliente.ClienteRetorno : []; const scoredEntries = customerRows.flatMap((customerRow) => { const deliveryRows = Array.isArray(customerRow?.ClienteEntrRetorno) ? customerRow.ClienteEntrRetorno : []; return deliveryRows.map((deliveryRow) => { const codEmitente = String(customerRow?.['cod-emitente'] || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); const localEntrega = String(deliveryRow?.['local-entrega'] || '').trim().toUpperCase(); const addressParts = [deliveryRow?.endereco, deliveryRow?.numero, deliveryRow?.complemento].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toUpperCase(); let score = 0; if (expectedCodEmitente && codEmitente === expectedCodEmitente) score += 5; if (expectedLocalEntrega && localEntrega === expectedLocalEntrega) score += 3; if (expectedAddress && addressParts.includes(expectedAddress)) score += 3; if (expectedAddressTokens.length > 0 && expectedAddressTokens.every((tokenPart) => addressParts.includes(tokenPart))) score += 2; return { localEntrega, score }; }); }).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score); const selectedEntry = scoredEntries[0] || null; const localEntrega = String(selectedEntry?.localEntrega || expectedLocalEntrega || '').trim(); if (!localEntrega) throw new Error('Consigaz local-entrega could not be resolved'); const boletoJson = await fetchJson(`${BASE_API}/Consulta2ViaBoleto?${new URLSearchParams({ cpfcnpj: cpfCnpj, 'data-fim': dateEnd, 'data-ini': dateStart, quitadas: 'no', origem: 'app-site', 'local-entrega': localEntrega }).toString()}`, { headers: authHeaders }); const notaJson = await fetchJson(`${BASE_API}/ConsultaNotaFiscal?${new URLSearchParams({ cpfcnpj: cpfCnpj, 'data-fim': dateEnd, 'data-ini': dateStart }).toString()}`, { headers: authHeaders }); const boletoRows = Array.isArray(boletoJson?.dsRetorno?.['tt-cliente-retorno']) ? boletoJson.dsRetorno['tt-cliente-retorno'] : []; const notaRows = Array.isArray(notaJson?.Notas?.NotasFiscais) ? notaJson.Notas.NotasFiscais : []; const billMap = new Map(); const upsertBill = (billId, patch) => { if (!billId) return; const existing = billMap.get(billId) || { bill_id: billId, reference_month: '', due_date: '', amount: '', status: '', barcode: '', issuer: ISSUER, rawData: {} }; billMap.set(billId, mergeEntry(existing, patch)); }; for (const notaRow of notaRows) { const duplicatas = Array.isArray(notaRow?.Duplicatas) ? notaRow.Duplicatas : []; const duplicata = duplicatas[0] || {}; const billId = String(notaRow?.['nr-nota-fis'] || duplicata?.['nr-nota-fis'] || '').trim(); const dueDateBr = toBrDate(duplicata?.['dt-venc'] || duplicata?.dt_venc); const issueDate = String(notaRow?.['dt-emis-nota'] || '').trim(); upsertBill(billId, { bill_id: billId, reference_month: normalizeReferenceMonth(notaRow?.referencia, issueDate || dueDateBr), due_date: dueDateBr, amount: normalizeAmount(notaRow?.['vl-tot-nota'] || duplicata?.['vl-dup'] || duplicata?.valor), status: inferDisplayStatus(duplicata?.situacao || notaRow?.situacao, dueDateBr), issuer: ISSUER, rawData: { notaFiscal: notaRow, duplicata } }); } for (const boletoRow of boletoRows) { const dadosGerais = Array.isArray(boletoRow?.['tt-dados-gerais']) ? boletoRow['tt-dados-gerais'][0] || {} : {}; const billId = String(boletoRow?.cod_tit_acr || dadosGerais?.cod_tit_acr || dadosGerais?.['cod-tit-acr'] || '').trim(); const dueDateBr = toBrDate(dadosGerais?.vencimento || boletoRow?.vencimento); upsertBill(billId, { bill_id: billId, reference_month: normalizeReferenceMonth(dadosGerais?.referencia, dueDateBr), due_date: dueDateBr, amount: normalizeAmount(dadosGerais?.['valor-total'] || boletoRow?.['valor-total'] || boletoRow?.saldo), status: String(boletoRow?.situacao_pagto || '').trim(), barcode: normalizeBarcode(dadosGerais?.['linha-digitavel'] || dadosGerais?.['codigo-barras'] || boletoRow?.['linha-digitavel'] || boletoRow?.['codigo-barras']), issuer: ISSUER, rawData: { boleto: boletoRow, dadosGerais } }); } const bills = Array.from(billMap.values()).filter((bill) => bill.reference_month && bill.amount).map((bill) => ({ ...bill, status: inferDisplayStatus(bill.status, bill.due_date) })).sort((left, right) => { const leftKey = toIsoDate(left.due_date) || `${left.reference_month}-99`; const rightKey = toIsoDate(right.due_date) || `${right.reference_month}-99`; return leftKey.localeCompare(rightKey); }); const primaryPending = bills.find((bill) => !isPaidStatus(bill.status)) || null; const primaryFallback = primaryPending || bills[bills.length - 1] || null; window.__codexConsigazBills = bills; window.__codexConsigazPrimary = primaryFallback; return JSON.stringify(bills); })(); })()

Espelhar a linha digitavel e o emissor prioritarios

issuer.script: (() => window.__codexConsigazPrimary?.issuer || 'Consigaz - Distribuidora de Gas Ltda - Barueri')()

notes: Coleta API-first do portal Consigaz para gerar notificação com a linha digitável real
Status de pagamento vem de ConsultaNotaFiscal e a linha digitável vem de Consulta2ViaBoleto
